Recruiter – Engineering & Energy

Location: Metro Denver, Colorado | Hybrid Work Arrangement

The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is seeking an experienced and motivated Recruiter – Engineering & Energy to support our engineering consulting teams primarily located in the Metro Denver area, as well as other regional offices across the United States and Canada.

This position is ideal for a resourceful, self-directed recruiter who enjoys building relationships, identifying technical talent, and partnering with hiring managers to meet evolving business needs.

The successful candidate will have strong full-cycle recruitment experience, with a particular emphasis on direct sourcing and engaging passive candidates. You will play an important role in attracting engineers, designers, project managers, and technical leaders to support our growing engineering consulting business, with a focus on the energy, oil and gas, and industrial sectors.
